account.note: PULLED LIVE AT 09:42 ET BY THE OPEN against the mandated account after a scope preflight that matched the mandate identifier EXACTLY AS A STRING against the connector list - one match, agentic-permitted, type cash; no first-account default, no nickname match, no balance heuristic. Every other account was discarded unread and none is summarised, totalled or mentioned in this file, in runs.json, in why.json, in the commit message or in the operator report. Portfolio, equity positions and option positions were each queried live and all returned first time: 1011.15 total against 1011.15 cash, buying power 1011.15, equity_value 0, options_value 0, futures 0, crypto 0, pending_deposits 0, unsettled 0.0000. THE TWENTY-FOURTH CONSECUTIVE IDENTICAL READ, unchanged from the 9/3 close and from every run of that session. The 1.99 credit first flagged by the 9/1 open remains STABLE and remains FLAGGED rather than explained; this run found no endpoint asserting a cause and does not assert one. ONE SPECIFICATION IS NOW OPEN AGAINST THIS CASH: the 09:45 buy of 7 HPE at a 54.21 limit commits 379.47, or 37.53% of the account, leaving 631.68 uncommitted. That is inside the 40% single-name ceiling and inside the mandate's two-position limit with one slot spare. BOTH POSITION LISTS ARE EMPTY, so no +20% target, no -8% equity stop, no -40% option stop, no ~5 session time stop and NO OPTION NO-FLY WINDOW was reachable - each tested live at 09:42 rather than inherited from yesterday's pre-close. The clock was corroborated rather than trusted: now-et.mjs read 13:41:06.646Z against an MDT venue_bid_time of 13:41:57.263953743Z, and again 13:45:34.252Z against an HPE venue_bid_time of 13:45:34.444541546Z two hundred milliseconds later - an exact -4 EDT offset from a venue this machine does not control.

entryWatch.setup: HPE day-2 pullback after the 9/3 outside reversal bar - THE LIVE SPECIFICATION, published 09:45, dies 15:30 ET today.
entryWatch.trigger: BUY 7 HPE AT A 54.21 LIMIT, struck inside a live 54.20 bid / 54.23 ask at 2026-09-04T13:45:34.444541546Z - one cent off the BID and below the 54.215 mid, deliberately NOT at the offer, because HPE has run 51.6079 to 54.64 in the first fourteen minutes and a limit at the offer would be buying the top tick of a vertical. Target 65.05 (+20%), stop 49.87 (-8%, seven cents above the 9/2 session low of 49.80), time stop the 2026-09-10 bell. FIVE INVALIDATIONS, FOUR OF THEM CLOSING TESTS: close below 51.83 (the 9/2 pre-print close, ALREADY pierced intraday at 51.6079 in the 13:31Z minute and reclaimed inside that minute - recorded in advance so no later run reads the wick as new); close below 51.6079; close below 50.29 (the midpoint of the 45.70-54.88 reaction bar); a TRADE below 49.87; or still open into 2026-09-10, closed at that bell ahead of the ORCL print regardless of price. An hourly seeing any of the first four kills or exits by APPENDING, never by editing, and never by re-striking the level higher.
entryWatch.why: The reaction bar is the entire argument and it is checkable: 9/3 opened 47.60, low 45.70, high 54.88, CLOSE 54.44 on 72,139,283 shares against a 19-30M base - sold 11.8% below a 51.83 pre-print close and bought all the way back. That is the exact inverse of the GTLB, SAIC, NTNX and OLLI round trips this board refused this week, and it is graded on the same test rather than a friendlier one. The closing-basis invalidations are the deliberate adoption of yesterday's MDT lesson at the only place the rulebook permits it - the next entry's list, written before the fact.

entryWatch.setup: NTAP - THE RUNNER-UP, kept as a watch rather than a candidate because it lost this morning's comparison on arithmetic and could win it back on a pullback.
entryWatch.trigger: THE LEVEL IS ITS 9/3 REACTION-BAR HIGH AND THE TEST IS THAT IT COMES BACK UNDER IT WITHOUT LOSING 180.77. NTAP quotes 187.25 bid / 188.00 ask at 2026-09-04T13:44:47.806891155Z, +1.30% against a 185.38 close, ABOVE its own 187.45 reaction-bar high - which is what disqualified it today: that is a breakout being bought, and the setup this rulebook names is the pullback. It is refused a second time on size, since the two shares that fit under the 40% ceiling are 37.1% of the account against seven HPE shares at 37.53%, the same money at a third of the granularity, on a 0.377% spread against 0.055%. NOT ACTIONABLE WHILE HPE IS OPEN IN ANY CASE: both are enterprise IT hardware, the mandate's ceiling is two positions and the rulebook's is two names in one complex, so a second entry here would be one position at twice the size paying two spreads.
entryWatch.why: Recorded so that tomorrow's run can see this was a close call decided on granularity and spread rather than on thesis, and can reverse it on evidence rather than re-deriving it from scratch. NTAP's reversal was LARGER than HPE's - it gapped to 161.00 against a 180.77 line and closed 185.38 - and if HPE's specification dies today unexecuted, NTAP is the first name to re-examine.

entryWatch.setup: THE NINE-NAME REACTION CLUSTER pre-registered here yesterday evening - ZS, DOCU, LULU, PATH, IOT, ASAN, GWRE, AMBA and PL. THE TEST WAS APPLIED THIS MORNING AND ALL NINE WERE REFUSED.
entryWatch.trigger: RESOLVED, NOT PENDING. The rule written before any number was known was that none of these is bought on its reaction bar, however good the print. Today is that bar for all nine and all nine are refused, unargued: GWRE -19.8%, PATH -17.7%, LULU -17.5%, ASAN -14.5%, AMBA -7.9%, ZS -3.6%, DOCU -1.9%, PL +0.3%, IOT +8.8%, each measured on the bid against its 9/3 settled close. IOT IS THE ONE THAT COST SOMETHING: +8.8% is the largest gain in the group and item 2 refuses it by name as the definitional wait signal rather than a buy. Any of these becomes eligible again only as a day-2 or day-3 pullback that HOLDS its 9/3 pre-print close, which is 177.80 for ZS, 65.97 DOCU, 121.77 LULU, 18.22 PATH, 38.75 IOT, 10.09 ASAN, 202.86 GWRE, 63.38 AMBA and 18.35 PL - all nine now quotable settled closes rather than the numbers that did not exist when this row was written.
entryWatch.why: Kept as a dead row rather than deleted because the value of a pre-commitment is only visible when the record shows it was honoured on a morning when it bound. It bound on IOT. The nine lines are carried forward so the 9/8 and 9/9 opens inherit them as numbers instead of re-deriving them.

THE 9/3 BAR IS THE THESIS: opened 47.60, low 45.70 (-11.8% against a 51.83 pre-print close), high 54.88, CLOSE 54.44 (+5.03%), on 72,139,283 shares against a 19-30M base. Sold a fifth of the way down on a 19.4% EPS beat and bought all the way back. TODAY IT PIERCED THE 51.83 LINE at 51.6079 in the 13:31Z minute on 198,197 shares and RECLAIMED INSIDE THAT MINUTE, then closed thirteen consecutive minutes higher - the pierce is recorded here in advance so no later run reads it as fresh. Catalyst: EPS 1.11 vs 0.93, revenue 12.21B vs 11.91B and +34% y/y; FY26 EPS raised to 3.75-3.85 from 3.35-3.45 vs 3.43 street; Q4 guided to 1.20-1.30 EPS vs 1.07 and 13.9-14.8B revenue vs 12.96B; networking orders +36%, server orders +75%, normalized orders +42%, AI backlog ~7B, a post-quarter multibillion-dollar hyperscaler server deal, FY27 revenue growth 13-17% and >=5B FCF. The bear case is margin mix and supply, and the sell-side is genuinely split - BofA 88 and Barclays 79 against Morgan Stanley 67, UBS 59 and Susquehanna 62, mean 69.05.

THE RUNNER-UP AND THE CLOSEST CALL OF THE MORNING. 187.25 bid / 188.00 ask at 2026-09-04T13:44:47.806891155Z, +1.30% against a 185.38 close, on a 0.75 spread that is 0.377% of mark.
